title: A miracle
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts 
in today’s Bible story you will see how 
powerful God is

Have you ever heard how God opens the SEA for His people to walk across?
Well
Did you know that 40 years after that
He does it again!
THIS TIME WITH A RIVER THAT WAS FLOODING!
Let us watch this video to see more

This time JOSHUA was the leader - Not Moses
It was the RIVER JORDAN - Not the Red Sea
It was the Israelite children - Not their stubborn, complaining parents
The priests carried a GOLDEN ARK from the Tabernacle
This time they crossed into the PROMISED LAND!

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus
You are so strong and so mighty
You can do anything
Thank you for caring for Your children
Thank you for caring for me and my family
Amen
